result.title: Watermarking Diffusion Language Models with Learned Foresight and Balanced Bands
result.summary: Green-red watermarks favor tokens from a green list that a secret key derives from the preceding tokens. Diffusion language models, however, often choose a token before its preceding tokens, and the token later shapes its neighbors' green lists. Prior work therefore tilts each choice to raise the expected number of green tokens at its own and its neighbors' positions. Building on this objective, we first learn two components that prior work keeps fixed: vocabulary bands that serve as green lists, separate competing candidates and keep the null distribution exact, and a foresight predictor that estimates how each candidate shifts its neighbors' predictions. Second, we count green tokens as the detector does, once per distinct context-token pair, so repetition earns nothing. On WaterBench with LLaDA-8B-Instruct, each learned component raises the z-score at equal distortion, and their gains are nearly additive. With a strong watermark, ours detects at least 96% of responses at a 1% false-positive rate while matching the LLM-judge score of unwatermarked text. Ours also detects more responses on Dream and as many or more on code and question answering without a significant loss in task accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究扩散语言模型的绿名单水印，将原先固定的词表绿名单 band 与「预见预测器」改为可学习，并按检测器口径每个不同上下文-token 对只计一次绿 token，在 WaterBench 上于同等失真下提高 z-score 与检测率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预见预测器」学习估计每个候选 token 如何改变邻近位置的预测分布，可能为 LVR 中预测某个候选 latent 步骤对后续推理状态的影响、进而支撑步骤选择与停止决策提供方法线索，可供核查。
